title: Ledger row (a Tag decisions row as a pull writes it)
description: One line of norm/queue.jsonl: a row of Tag decisions as plain values keyed by the Notion column names (the eighteen of TD in lib/config.mjs). One row per claim and tag the agent judged. The agent writes the proposal columns, Agent status, Decided under (where it records a decision, as the edition, or "<edition> · agreed <Outcome>" for a tick) and the reading columns (Agent's view of your decision, Rule, Why the agent thinks so, Read under, READ-DECISIONS.md, lib/readings.mjs). The editor writes Agent is right, Tag outcome and Your note; no script does. decided is true when Tag outcome is set, or Agent is right is ticked on a sure proposal (rowDecision in lib/decisions.mjs).

Open claim.description: The Claims page of the row (a relation, one page id).

Key.description: The claim's Geo ID, two colons, the tag.

Agent is right.description: The editor ticks it to take the proposal as it stands; a tick on Can't tell decides nothing.

Tag outcome.description: The editor's decision; it wins over a tick.

Your note.description: The editor's own words; never parsed.

Agent's view of your decision.description: The agent's reading of a disagreement between the decision and its proposal; empty for a row that agrees or is not read yet.

Rule.description: The rule the reading points at, for example Context-dependent rule 3; empty when no single rule is the point.

Why the agent thinks so.description: One line of why; it starts with "without your note · " when the editor wrote no note.

Rulebook edition.description: The edition the current proposal was made under.

Decided under.description: The edition the decision was made under, or "<edition> · agreed <Outcome>" for a tick.

Read under.description: The cache key of the reading, "<edition> · <hash8>":  a row is read again only when the hash differs from the current one.
